items.reason: Two registered EXPERIMENTAL arms ('Phase 0 Part' and 'Phase Ia Part'), neither of which works as a control; R8: 'no' = more than one arm but none works as a control; 'not_applicable' is reserved for single-arm trials.

note: TP53 wild type (Phase Ia entry requirement) + MDM2 inhibitor brigimadlin is a clear match (both coders agree); eligibility vs enrichment role split is priority 3 and does not change the outcome. MGMT unmethylated promoter is a required value for Phase Ia, i.e. eligibility under D31-A8 (any_molecular_selection already true). control_arm 'no' is consistent with D31-C4.
